mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in GDP signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of quarters with 2%+ GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling tightening monetary policy, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS increases by 200k+ over 3 months, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be positive over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:strong labor markets and equity returns
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A 5% monthly increase in INDPRO signals increased industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expectations of higher earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of months with 5%+ INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1200k units, signaling strong housing demand, and RSAFS increases by 10% over 1 month, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be positive over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer confidence.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in strong housing demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% decrease in FEDFUNDS over 2 months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to decreased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 50% of easing cycles (FEDFUNDS 2mo change < -0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 6%, signaling a weakening labor market, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days due to decreased consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 40% of weakening labor market periods (UNRATE > 6%).

mechanism_narrative: A 10% monthly increase in RSAFS signals increased retail sales, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expectations of higher earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 30% of months with 10%+ RSAFS growth.
